errors.text_span: mit einer Markierung in Form eines kleinen Kreises
errors.evidence: The description states that the line has small circle markers, but the line in the chart is solid without any markers.

errors.text_span: sinkt sie allmählich auf etwa 0 Euro/MWh im September 2024
errors.evidence: The description claims the value drops to 0 Euro/MWh in September 2024, but the chart shows the value is still around +1 Euro/MWh at that time. The line does not cross 0 until late October 2024.

errors.text_span: Zwischen Oktober 2024 und November 2024 fällt die Linie stark auf etwa -6 Euro/MWh ab
errors.evidence: The description states that the line falls to -6 Euro/MWh between October and November 2024. However, the chart shows the line falls to approximately -3 Euro/MWh in November. The value of -6 Euro/MWh is not reached until January 2025.
The description fails to mention the prominent horizontal black line at the y-axis value of 0, which serves as an important visual reference for when the values become negative.
